'''Lancer4life WYS the one the great way''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lancer4life]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 WYS Lancer4life LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

An old deck that i think can still do descent.
